$comment: The test-build debug deep link <scheme>://debug/setup?<param>=<value>&... Every parameter is optional; an unknown parameter or value is refused (logged, and S15 opens) instead of being ignored. The parser packages/shell/src/screens/debug/debug-link.ts has exactly these parameters (check-e2e-setup rule debug-link). Kinds: a list of allowed values, or integer, date (YYYY-MM-DD), stars (demo or <level>:<stars>,...).

lang.effect: forced app language (direction follows; fa and ckb are right-to-left)

theme.effect: theme setting (system for the screenshot matrix: the simulator appearance decides)

seed.effect: level seed override (0..4294967295), kept by debugServices.setSeed

level.effect: makes this the next level (1 to the last level): earlier levels won, this and later ones cleared, the saved run dropped

date.effect: fake clock date for daily challenges and streaks (S15 set date)

ads.effect: S15 never ads / always test ads; only matters in an ADS_MODE=test build (E2E and screenshots use ADS_MODE=off builds, which never start the SDK)

premium.effect: Premium on or off without a purchase (S15): debugServices.setPremium writes the save, then dispatches debug-premium-set

offline.effect: simulate offline (S15): debugServices.setOffline flips SimulatedConnectivity, which tells every ConnectivityPort subscriber (ads, store, S12)

firstRun.effect: 1 = first-launch state (S2 next); 0 = language chosen, tutorial done. When it switches the navigator's group, screen= opens on the next navigation state (one link is enough); action= then needs a second link

stars.effect: progress fixtures: demo (levels 1-11 won, the screenshot fixture) or <level>:<stars>,... with stars 0-3 (0 clears the level)

screen.effect: opens a route (kebab-case) or one of the game's example states

action.effect: ends the level on screen with that outcome: the game host swaps the run's state for testing.examples.win() or lose() and runs its one run-end path (stars, statistics, ad history saved before Result shows). Send it in a link of its own once the level is on screen; without an active run it is an error

boardLayout.effect: 1 renders game.board-layout; off by default so screenshots never show it

geo.effect: consent geography of the next consent moment (admob-ads' ads smoke test on an ADS_MODE=test build): debugServices.setConsentGeography resets Google's UMP answer (ads on only) and rebuilds the consent port with debugGeography; eea shows Google's form on any network, other only Apple's tracking prompt. Kept across a reload. An ADS_MODE=off build never calls UMP
